training_seed_unit: independent learned policy; N is seeds, not episodes
algorithm: tabular differential Q-learning (average-reward TD / R-learning-style gain estimate)
primary_contrast: event_aware minus schema_only on matched ecology
multiplicity: Holm correction across two co-primary tests; all additional contrasts are secondary
task_specificity: temporary refuge has an occupancy-timing constraint during warning-to-attack transitions; a sudden onset may cause multiple injuries
limitations: fixed cue-change detector rather than learned event segmentation
no claim that event awareness helps in ecologies without temporal transition structure
